entries.name: Postgres 18.7 patch
entries.reason: CVE-2026-6460 is fixed in 18.7 and 17.12, and every Postgres server I run was below the fix.
entries.result: 13 of 13 running servers were below the fix (12 on 18.6, 1 on 17.11). Patched. Postgres 19 stays on hold: pgvector has no pg19 tag yet.

entries.name: MCP tool description trimming
entries.reason: Shorter tool descriptions cost fewer tokens in every session that loads the server.
entries.result: 10 tools: 9122 to 7355 bytes (-19.4%, about 2280 to 1838 tokens by a chars/4 estimate). Descriptions only; the build is clean and no test asserts description text.

entries.name: Tailscale netmap caching
entries.reason: It needs a control-plane node attribute that headscale 0.29.7 may not send, and it would not fix the WARP routing clash.
entries.result: Unknown whether headscale sends the attribute. Cheapest next test: stop the control plane for a minute and ping a peer.

entries.name: gh event listen for PR waits
entries.reason: Waiting for PR events instead of polling would save API calls, but the feature is a preview this account is not in.
entries.result: Needs gh 2.105 or newer. A live call returned HTTP 403: event subscriptions are not enabled for this account. Retest once enrolled.

entries.name: System.ServiceModel.Syndication for feeds
entries.reason: It replaces a hand-written RSS and Atom parser, but it rejects a whole feed over unescaped HTML the old parser reads.
entries.result: The swap worked and removed 7 lines. 30 of 31 parser tests passed. On a corpus of 17 feeds (about 250 entries) there were no title, link, id or date mismatches.
